https://www.worldvaluessurvey.org/WVSNewsShow.jsp?ID=428 (Cultural_Map_scores_2022.xls, official WVS 2022 Cultural Map country scores, one point per country)
meta.notes: All numeric values were pulled directly from official World Values Survey Association downloadable data files (.xlsx/.xls), not estimated from images. trad_sec = Traditional(+)/Secular-rational(-) is inverted here to match the convention trad_sec negative=secular, positive=traditional as used in the WVS TradAgg column (higher TradAgg = more traditional). surv_self = Survival(-)/Self-expression(+) values, higher = more self-expression, from SurvSAgg. The 'wvs2023_country_year_raw' and wave-band editions are derived from the same underlying 2023 data file (413 country-survey-year observations spanning WVS waves 1-7, 1981-2022); wave-band editions average all observations whose survey year falls in that wave's date range for each country. The 'wvs_official_2022_map' edition is the exact single-point-per-country dataset WVS published to accompany their 2022 map graphic. No values were fabricated or eyeballed from map images.
